posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md: yes nice hologram tony. it looks as if your broadly reflecting hologram is showing the chromatic blur you get as your object appears further into the plate. if you were to reprocess to narrow its replay the green banding in the black stripes would dissappear ......

posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
> **Dutchelm05:** Thank you Dave,Is there something on Wiki as to how the reprocessing is done?If this was done does it narrow the viewing angle?Tony

no it wont effect the viewing angle at all, as a matter of fact it will give you greater depth, as only one color is allowed to be reflected and the narrower the color band the greater the depth (also dimmer). this narrow banding or color tuning is what you want to achieve to make efficient green master hologram for making H2s
